content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Music online

Selling music online and accepting Bitcoin is now a viable option, thanks to the development of sovereign digital commerce stacks. These stacks provide a complete solution for creators to sell their products, including music, without relying on restricted platforms. By utilizing GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for automatic crypto payment verification, creators can maintain full ownership and control over their sales and customer data.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of these sovereign stacks is designed to be efficient, secure, and scalable. By leveraging free and paid tools, creators can set up a fully operational online store with automatic crypto payment processing and instant product delivery. The use of Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery ensures that creators have a reliable and secure way to manage their sales and products.
Who This Is Built For and Why

The product types that work with automated crypto delivery are any digital files that can be stored and delivered via download link: ebooks in PDF or EPUB format, courses packaged as ZIP archives, Notion templates exported as files or share links, font families as ZIP archives of OTF and TTF files, Lightroom or Capture One preset packs, beat files as WAV or MP3 archives, plugin installers, stock photo packs, software license keys, and any other file-based product. The delivery system in Stack 01 uses Google Drive shared links. Stack 02 uses Cloudflare R2 presigned URLs with configurable expiry times — typically 24 to 72 hours — which prevents download links from being shared indefinitely after a single purchase.
Sovereign digital commerce stacks provide a platform-agnostic solution for selling digital products.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The order management layer gives you complete visibility into every transaction your store processes. In Stack 01, every order is logged to a Google Sheet with the buyer's email, product purchased, payment amount in crypto and USD equivalent, transaction hash for on-chain verification, and delivery status. In Stack 02, orders are stored in a Supabase PostgreSQL database with the same fields plus additional metadata. Both can be exported as CSV at any time. The transaction hash provides cryptographic proof of every payment that does not depend on any platform's records — you can verify any transaction independently on a public blockchain explorer.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack today, creators can start by selecting the components that best fit their needs. With the Complete Builder Kit ($197), creators can access all 6 blueprints and 7 templates necessary to build, deploy, and scale their online store. By following the included scaling playbook and integration guides, creators can quickly set up a fully operational store and start selling their products, including music, to a global audience.

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, creators can utilize a sovereign digital commerce stack, leveraging GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for automatic crypto payment verification. This solution provides a platform-agnostic way to sell digital products, including ebooks, and maintain full ownership and control over sales and customer data.
NOWPayments offers a 0.5% fee, significantly lower than Gumroad's 10% fee.

For creators looking to sell digital downloads without platform fees, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides a comprehensive solution. Available for instant download at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html, this kit includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates necessary to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack. By utilizing this solution, creators can sell their products, including music, templates, and fonts, without relying on restricted platforms or incurring excessive fees.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack, start by selecting a hosting platform, such as GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, set up backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, and integrate NOWPayments for automatic crypto payment verification. Then, configure order storage using Supabase or Google Sheets, and set up file delivery using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Finally, test and deploy your store, and start selling your products to a global audience.
